name: Avalon: The Lost Kingdom

features.name: Increasing multipliers
features.description: Free spins wins get a random 2x–7x multiplier that rises.

features.name: Excalibur feature
features.description: Adds extra wilds during free spins.

review:
Avalon: The Lost Kingdom is an Arthurian 5x3, 20-line slot. The wild replaces any symbol in a line, and three or more scatters trigger free spins that can be retriggered.

During free spins, every win is multiplied by an increasing random multiplier from 2x to 7x, and the Excalibur feature can appear at random to place extra wilds on the reels. That combination of extra wilds and rising multipliers is where the bigger wins come from. BGaming rates the game high volatility with a 3,812x maximum. Note the RTP is 94.56%, below most modern slots. Free spins arrive about once every 153 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
